BiblicalUsage: Mesuwkah is a hedge, the fence that keeps a vineyard safe. Isaiah 5:5 has God say He will take away the hedge of His vineyard, and it shall be eaten up, and Proverbs 15:19 says the way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns, but the way of the righteous is made plain.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the hedge is God's protection, and losing it is the judgment: a vineyard without a hedge is food for anything that passes.
